shots.focal_element: The cursor moving through the Apollo app: Deals board, then the Analytics dashboards list, the Email Engagement Performance dashboard and its bar charts, then the Plays page and its All templates button
on_screen_text: Get started with your own custom Reports and Dashboards from the training videos or find a deeper dive within our Knowledge Base.
shots.typography: Native product UI text only: small sans-serif (low-confidence guess: Inter or a similar system UI face), medium-weight sentence-case page titles, regular-weight labels and chart axes, normal tracking; no added captions or motion-graphic type.
shots.what_happens: A long cursor-guided screen recording under the voice-over for Deal Intelligence, Analytics and Plays (w269-w339): the Deals kanban board is shown with slow digital zoom/pan reframes, the cursor clicks Analytics in the sidebar, the dashboards list appears, a search narrows it and Email Engagement Performance is opened (a brief loading state, then horizontal bar charts), a chart is opened in detail, then the cursor clicks Plays and moves to the All templates button, which opens a modal at the very end of the shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Play a real 1280x720 screen capture of the app and animate a CSS transform scale/translate on the capture layer (about 1.0 to 1.4x, ease-in-out over roughly 0.5 s) at each click so the camera pushes in on the clicked sidebar item and then pulls back to the full page.

shots.focal_element: The Play templates modal card grid, cropped and zoomed so the cards fill the left two-thirds while the dimmed page and the All templates button sit at right
on_screen_text: Upsell when users hit a limit
shots.typography: Native product UI: bold sans-serif sentence-case card titles, regular-weight centered body copy, small outlined button labels; no added type.
shots.what_happens: A sub-half-second frame (about 0.38 s) of the Play templates modal appearing over a dimmed page while heavily zoomed in on its card grid; the cursor still rests on the All templates button. It reads as the first frames of the modal open plus the start of a zoom that resolves in s013.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to the capture of the modal opening with the capture layer held at about 1.6x scale anchored to the top-left of the modal, ready to animate back toward 1.0x in the next shot.

shots.focal_element: The full Play templates modal centered on a dimmed page, with its category sidebar and three-column card grid
shots.transition_other: digital zoom-out reframe continuing from s012: the zoomed-in modal crop pulls back to show the whole modal
on_screen_text: Upsell when users hit a limit
shots.typography: Native product UI: medium-weight sans-serif modal title and section heading, regular-weight sidebar category labels with small count badges, bold sentence-case card titles, regular centered descriptions; normal tracking.
shots.what_happens: Under the line about streamlining with Apollo's plays and the 'So if you're ready to close more deals' setup (w336-w347), the view settles on the whole Play templates modal; the framing drifts slightly (a small zoom/pan) and the card grid scrolls down a little to reveal a third row, while the cursor stays parked at the top right. The last contact-sheet frame (1:56.000) already shows the presenter, so the cut to s014 lands within a frame or two of the detected boundary.
shots.build_rebuild: Hold the modal capture centered on a dimmed backdrop and run a slow 1.05x to 1.0x scale ease-out over about 4 s while the inner grid scrolls by about one card row.

shots.focal_element: The presenter seated at a wooden desk, hands clasped, speaking to camera, with a closed silver laptop at left, a plant and a ring light in the dark background
shots.what_happens: Hard cut back to the presenter on a locked-off medium shot as he delivers the call to action, 'head over to apollo.io today and create an account for free' (w348-w359), smiling at the end; no on-screen URL or button is shown in this shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to a locked-off 16:9 medium shot of the presenter centered at a desk against a dark set with a shallow-focus plant and ring light, and hold it for the full spoken CTA with no overlays.
